title: Vertical coefficient-component naturality
statement:
theorem trfAutomorphismCoefficientComponent_vertical
    (n : ℕ) {U V : S.ProEt} (f : U ⟶ V) :
    (trfAutomorphismRawRing l E g).obj.map
        (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 n) f).op ≫
      trfAutomorphismCoefficientComponent l E g (op (n, U)) =
    trfAutomorphismCoefficientComponent l E g (op (n, V)) ≫
      (coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E S).obj.map
        (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 n) f).op

source.place: Tags 03CZ and 09A5; vertical and horizontal factorization of sequence-site arrows.

proof.text: Naturality of the finite inverse-image coefficient isomorphism on the pro-etale site gives the equality after forgetting commutativity; the sequence-site map at fixed index is the corresponding vertical restriction.

source.place: Tags 03CZ and 09A5; vertical and horizontal factorization of sequence-site arrows.

proof_origin.note: Split from the arbitrary-arrow naturality proof; the componentwise vertical/horizontal clauses are strictly simpler.
